3.name: Circle of the Land Spells & Land's Aid (Circle of the Land)
3.description: Attune to an Arid, Polar, Temperate, or Tropical land for prepared spells, and expend Wild Shape to deal Necrotic damage and restore HP in a 10-foot sphere.

6.name: Natural Recovery (Circle of the Land)
6.description: Cast one of your Circle Spells once per Long Rest without a spell slot, and recover expended spell slots totaling up to half your Druid level on a Short Rest.

10.name: Nature's Ward (Circle of the Land)
10.description: Gain Immunity to the Poisoned condition and Resistance to the damage type tied to your chosen Land.

14.name: Nature's Sanctuary (Circle of the Land)
14.description: Expend Wild Shape to create a 15-foot Cube granting allies Half Cover and Resistance matching your chosen Land.

lands_aid.name: Land's Aid
lands_aid.hint: Expend Wild Shape: 10-ft sphere CON save vs Necrotic damage and restore the same dice of HP to one ally.

3.name: Circle Forms & Moon Spells (Circle of the Moon)
3.description: Assume higher-CR Beast shapes (up to Druid level / 3) with AC equal to 13 + WIS modifier and Temporary HP equal to 3x Druid level.

6.name: Improved Circle Forms (Circle of the Moon)
6.description: Your Beast attacks can deal Radiant damage, and you add your WIS modifier to Constitution saving throws while in Wild Shape.

10.name: Moonlight Step (Circle of the Moon)
10.description: Teleport up to 30 feet as a Bonus Action WIS modifier times per Long Rest and gain Advantage on your next attack roll.

14.name: Lunar Form (Circle of the Moon)
14.description: Add +2d10 Radiant damage once per turn in Wild Shape and bring a willing ally when using Moonlight Step.

lunar_form.name: Lunar Radiance
lunar_form.hint: Once per turn in Wild Shape, deal extra Radiant damage on a hit.

3.name: Circle of the Sea Spells & Wrath of the Sea (Circle of the Sea)
3.description: Always have Sea spells prepared, and expend Wild Shape as a Bonus Action to create a 5-foot Emanation dealing Cold damage and pushing targets.

6.name: Aquatic Affinity (Circle of the Sea)
6.description: Your Wrath of the Sea Emanation grows to 10 feet and grants you a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

10.name: Stormborn (Circle of the Sea)
10.description: While Wrath of the Sea is active, gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and Resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder damage.

14.name: Oceanic Gift (Circle of the Sea)
14.description: Instead of centering Wrath of the Sea on yourself, surround a willing creature within 60 feet (or split between yourself and an ally with two Wild Shape uses).

wrath_of_the_sea.name: Wrath of the Sea
wrath_of_the_sea.hint: Bonus Action in your Emanation: CON save vs Cold damage equal to WIS modifier d6s and 15-ft push.

3.name: Star Map & Starry Form (Circle of the Stars)
3.description: Gain Guidance, Guiding Bolt, and a Star Map focus, and expend Wild Shape as a Bonus Action to assume Archer, Chalice, or Dragon Starry Form.

6.name: Cosmic Omen (Circle of the Stars)
6.description: Roll a die after each Long Rest to grant Weal (+1d6) or Woe (-1d6) via Reaction to d20 Tests within 30 feet (PB uses per Long Rest).

10.name: Twinkling Constellations (Circle of the Stars)
10.description: Archer and Chalice scale to 2d8, Dragon grants a 20-foot Fly Speed, and you can switch your Starry Form at the start of each turn.

14.name: Full of Stars (Circle of the Stars)
14.description: While in Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal and gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

starry_form_archer.name: Starry Form: Archer
starry_form_archer.hint: Bonus Action ranged spell attack (60 ft) dealing 1d8 + WIS mod Radiant damage (2d8 at L10).

starry_form_chalice.name: Starry Form: Chalice
starry_form_chalice.hint: When you cast a healing spell with a slot, restore an extra 1d8 + WIS mod HP (2d8 at L10) within 30 ft.
